Game Overview

O.M.I.N.O puts players into a arcade experience centered on fly through an alien-invaded pixelated universe as a daring human, skillfully dodging hostile spaceships while collecting valuable coins. O.M.I.N.O delivers fast-paced action with simple controls, requiring strategic reflexes and quick thinking in an ever-increasing challenge that tests your mastery of tapping to survive.
